definitions.explanation: The side of something facing south, or the area to the south of a reference point. South-facing sides are valued in housing because they receive more sunlight.

examples.japanese: {南側|みなみがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧。
examples.english: Rooms on the south side are bright.
We made a garden on the south side of the house.

examples.japanese: {南側|みなみがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ベランダ→ベランダ：05072_beranda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Apartments with a south-facing balcony are popular.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧ (south) + ⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧ (side). South-facing properties (⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧) are highly valued in Japanese real estate because they receive sunlight throughout the day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南側|みなみがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧: south-facing window
- {南側|みなみがわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{面|めん}する→面する：14629_mensuru⟧: to face south
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{南側|みなみがわ}: south side of the station
- {南側|みなみがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: south-facing room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{北側|きたがわ}→北側：27541_kitagawa⟧: north side
- {東側|ひがしがわ}: east side
- ⟦{西側|にしがわ}→西側：27563_nishigawa⟧: west side
- ⟦{南向|みなみむ}き→南向き：22595_minamimuki⟧: south-facing (as a property attribute)
